report: Revision Kohn-Sham theory (SPEC sections 1, 7): independent exact sympy derivation and checks
coordinates: the author's coordinates {x0, ..., x7}: x0 = the hidden direction (y = ln|sin 6Hx0|/(6H) <= 0 on every quarter); x1, x2, x3 = 3-space; x4 = time; x5, x6, x7 = the extra times; the corrected metric of 2026-10-16 (version 2), general a4(x4), b4(x4) > 0, every real z

checks.name: fixture_input
checks.detail: gammas read from Revision/algebra/reports/python-gammas.json (sha256 7388509a974f4d9dc383bb5d89cb16818ed01dc5a59784eb8f3e2d6742fcddbe)

checks.name: fixture_python_equals_wolfram
checks.detail: the Python-built and the Wolfram-built T16 (Revision/algebra) agree entry by entry

checks.name: clifford_relation
checks.detail: {gamma^a, gamma^b} = 2 eta^ab, eta = diag(+1,+1,+1,+1,-1,-1,-1,-1) in x0..x7

checks.name: C_B_Gamma
checks.detail: C = g0 g1 g2 g3 real symmetric, C^2 = 1; B = -i C g4 Hermitian, B^2 = 1; Gamma = g0 g1..g7 = diag(-I8, I8)

checks.name: BC_and_Cg4
checks.detail: BC = -i gamma^(x4), C gamma^(x4) = i B, C B C = B (used in the exchange and the EMT)

checks.name: geometry_hidden_coordinate
checks.detail: y = ln|sin z|/(6H) = ln(sin^2 z)/(12H): dy = cot z dx0 for every real z (x0 real), cot^2 z dx0^2 = dy^2, (sin^2 z)^{1/6} = e^{2Hy}; every quarter of the period of z is y in (-inf, 0) (the fold cos z = 0 is y = 0)

checks.name: geometry_sqrt_det
checks.detail: det g = e^{-2a4} b4^4 cot^2 z |sin z| in the author's chart (every real z): sqrt|g| = e^{-a4} b4^2 |cot z| (sin^2 z)^{1/4}; in the y chart sqrt|g| = e^{3a4} f^4 e^{3Hy} = e^{-a4} b4^2 e^{3Hy}, f = e^{-a4} b4^{1/2}

checks.name: geometry_line_element
checks.detail: ds^2 = e^{2a4(x4)} dx_{1..3}^2 - dx4^2 + f(x4)^2 [dy^2 - e^{2Hy} dx_{5..7}^2], f = e^{-a4} b4^{1/2} (the corrected metric with (sin^2 z)^{1/6} = e^{2Hy} and cot^2 z dx0^2 = dy^2), vielbein h = (f, e^{a4} x3, 1, f e^{Hy} x3) in the order (y, x1..x7)

checks.name: spin_connection_compatibility
checks.detail: canonical omega_mu^a_b = e^a_nu nabla_mu e_b^nu, Omega_mu = (1/2) omega_mu ab S^ab: d_mu gamma^nu + Gamma^nu_{mu lam} gamma^lam + [Omega_mu, gamma^nu] = 0 for all 64 (mu, nu), a4 = a4(x4), b4 = b4(x4)

checks.name: spin_connection_slash
checks.detail: gamma^mu Omega_mu = (3/2)(H/f) gamma^(x0) + (b4'/b4 - a4'/2) gamma^(x4) exactly for a4 = a4(x4), b4 = b4(x4) (f = e^{-a4} b4^{1/2}; = (3/2) H e^{a4} b4^{-1/2} gamma^(x0) + ...)

checks.name: spin_connection_time_terms
checks.detail: per direction: the hidden direction gives (1/2) h4 gamma^(x4), 3-space (3/2) a4' gamma^(x4), the extra times (3/2) h4 gamma^(x4) + (3/2)(H/f) gamma^(x0), h4 = b4'/(2 b4) - a4'; Omega_x4 = 0, Omega_y != 0 (f depends on x4)

checks.name: spin_connection_slash_x0_chart
checks.detail: in the author's chart x0..x7 (e^x0 = e^{-a4} b4^{1/2} cot z signed, (sin^2 z)^{1/12} = (s sin z)^{1/6} for each sign s of sin z, i.e. every real z), a4 = a4(x4), b4 = b4(x4): gamma^mu Omega_mu = (3/2) H e^{a4} b4^{-1/2} gamma^(x0) + (b4'/b4 - a4'/2) gamma^(x4) too

checks.name: ansatz_removes_spin_connection
checks.detail: gamma^mu D_mu (e^{ik.x} e^{-(3/2)Hy} e^{a4/2} b4^{-1} chi(y, x4)) = e^{ik.x} e^{-(3/2)Hy} e^{a4/2} b4^{-1} [(1/f) g0 d_y chi + g4 d_x4 chi + i kappa k_j g^j chi], kappa = e^{-a4(x4)} (no y): exact, for time-dependent a4 and b4, good sector

checks.name: ansatz_without_y_factor_term_survives
checks.detail: without the factor e^{-(3/2)Hy} the term (3/2)(H/f) gamma^(x0) chi survives

checks.name: ansatz_without_x4_factor_term_survives
checks.detail: without the factor e^{a4/2} b4^{-1} the term (b4'/b4 - a4'/2) gamma^(x4) chi survives: e^{-(3/2)Hy} e^{a4/2} b4^{-1} is the half-density of sqrt|g| = e^{-a4} b4^2 e^{3Hy}

checks.name: ansatz_norm
checks.detail: sqrt|g| (e^{-(3/2)Hy} e^{a4/2} b4^{-1})^2 = 1 in the y chart: int sqrt|g| Psi^dag Psi over the hidden direction equals int chi^dag chi dy for every a4 and b4 (the Hilbert norm of the reduced problem)

checks.name: hamiltonian_16_hermitian
checks.detail: i d_x4 chi = h chi, h = (i/f) g4 g0 d_y (g4 g0 real symmetric, so (i/f) g4 g0 d_y is Hermitian) - kappa k_j g4 g^j + M (-i g4) + v: i g4 g0, g4 g^j, -i g4 are Hermitian, (-i g4)^2 = 1; the KS covariant equation is gamma^mu D_mu Psi = (M_eff - i v_v g4) Psi; the Hilbert norm int chi^dagger chi dy (= int sqrt|g| Psi^dagger Psi over the hidden direction) is conserved when the boundary terms vanish

checks.name: blocks_commuting_set
checks.detail: J = g0 g1 g4 (J^2 = 1), K1 = g2 g3, K2 = g5 g6 (K^2 = -1) commute with each other and with gamma^(x0), gamma^(x0)gamma^(x1), gamma^(x0)gamma^(x4), B, C

checks.name: blocks_projectors
checks.detail: P(j,s2,s3) = (1+jJ)/2 (1-i s2 K1)/2 (1-i s3 K2)/2: eight rank-2 orthogonal projectors summing to 1

checks.name: blocks_forms
checks.detail: in block (j,s2,s3): g0 = s3(Pauli), g0g1 = -i sigma2, g0g4 = j sigma1, B = j s2, C = s2 sigma2, BC = j sigma2, g4g1 = -j sigma3, B g0 = j s2 sigma3, J = j, K1 = i s2, K2 = i s3 (all block diagonal)

checks.name: blocks_not_everything_block_diagonal
checks.detail: gamma^(x2), gamma^(x5), gamma^(x0)gamma^(x2) are not block diagonal (they anticommute with J), gamma^(x1) is; the reduction uses k along x1 (rotational invariance, check rotation_invariance)

checks.name: blocks_relation_to_Gamma
checks.detail: Gamma anticommutes with J and commutes with K1, K2: it maps block (j,s2,s3) onto (-j,s2,s3); in the basis V its 2x2 entries between paired blocks are s2 sigma2: Gamma V_beta = s2 V_{beta'} sigma2

checks.name: block_hamiltonian
checks.detail: h_16 restricted to block (j,s2,s3), k = (k,0,0): h_j = j[-(i/f) sigma1 d_y + M sigma2 + kappa k sigma3] + v (kappa = e^{-a4}, f = e^{-a4} b4^{1/2}); equivalently chi' = f N chi, N = M sigma3 - kappa k sigma2 + i j (epsilon - v) sigma1

checks.name: block_ode_equivalent
checks.detail: h_j chi = epsilon chi is equivalent to chi' = f N chi for j = +-1 (the factor f multiplies both sides of -(i j/f) sigma1 chi' = (epsilon - v - j(M sigma2 + kappa k sigma3)) chi)

checks.name: block_type_relation
checks.detail: h_{-1} - v = -(h_{+1} - v) (spectra mirrored); sigma3 h_j(k) sigma3 = h_{-j}(-k): the (j,k) and (-j,-k) orbitals are degenerate, chi_{-j,-k} = sigma3 chi_{j,k}

checks.name: block_Gamma_map
checks.detail: sigma2 h_j(M, k) sigma2 = h_{-j}(-M, k) (the block form of Gamma): Gamma maps a solution of block type j with mass M onto block type -j with mass -M at the same k and epsilon (v fixed); it exchanges chi2(0) = 0 and chi1(0) = 0 (the two brane parities)

checks.name: rotation_invariance
checks.detail: the spinor rotation cos(th/2) + sin(th/2) g1 g2 commutes with g0, g4, B, C and rotates k.gamma: the spectrum depends on |k| only; every computation may take k = (k, 0, 0)

checks.name: gas_mode_projector
checks.detail: flat good-sector plane waves e^{-i eps x4 + i p.x} (p in the four space-like directions x0,x1,x2,x3): h_p = M(-i g4) - p_a g4 g^a, h_p^2 = (M^2 + p^2) 1: eps = +-E, each 8-fold (the 8-fold gas); G_p = (1 + h_p/E)/2 is the Hermitian rank-8 projector on the positive-energy modes

checks.name: gas_angular_average
checks.detail: the angular average over S^2 of the one-body matrix G_p B of the 8 modes at momentum p is (B + (M/E) C)/2; the terms linear in p vanish (also for a y-momentum averaged over +-p0); only p -> -p symmetry is needed

checks.name: gas_negative_energy_modes
checks.detail: occupied negative-energy modes give (B - (M/E) C)/2: the local one-body matrix of ANY p -> -p symmetric occupation (any temperature, Mermin) has the form rho = (n B + S C)/16

checks.name: gas_densities
checks.detail: with <Psi^dagger M Psi> = Tr(M rho), rho = sum_occ f u u^dagger B (the expectation-value rule u^dagger B M u): number density n = <Psi^dagger B Psi> = Tr(B rho), scalar density S = <Psibar Psi> = Tr(C rho)

checks.name: hf_wick_contraction
checks.detail: quasi-free state with one-body function f_AB = <Psi_A^dag Psi_B> = rho_BA: <:S^2:> = sum C_AB C_CD (f_AB f_CD - f_AD f_CB) = (Tr C rho)^2 - Tr(C rho C rho) (verified by brute force on an explicit two-mode state)

checks.name: exchange_uniform_gas
checks.detail: e_x = -(lambda/2) Tr(C rho C rho) = -lambda*(S**2 + n**2)/32 for rho = (nB + SC)/16 (C B C = B, Tr BC = 0): exactly local in (n, S) at every temperature; Hartree e_H = (lambda/2) S^2

checks.name: ks_potentials
checks.detail: e_int = e_H + e_x = (15/32) lambda S^2 - (1/32) lambda n^2; M_eff = m + d e_int/dS = m + (15/16) lambda S, v_v = d e_int/dn = -lambda n/16 (enters h as + v_v 1, the covariant equation as -i v_v gamma^(x4))

checks.name: ks_onshell_lagrangian
checks.detail: on shell <L>/sqrt|g| = M_eff S + v_v n - m S - e_int = e_int (e_int homogeneous of degree 2), i.e. the operator identity <L> = <U> on shell evaluated in Hartree-Fock

checks.name: filled_shell_ratio
checks.detail: one filled 8-fold level at rest (n = S = 8 per unit volume): E_x/E_H = -1/8

checks.name: exchange_slab_exact_fock
checks.detail: a level with 2x2 density D = (d0 + d1 s1 + d2 s2 + d3 s3)/2 in each of the 4 blocks of type j = +1 and sigma3 D sigma3 in the 4 blocks of type -1 (the degenerate (-j,-k) partners), averaged over a k -> -k closed shell (= the projection onto the 64-dim commutant of the 3-space rotations; End(16) carries only spin 0 and 1): n = 8 d0, S = 8 d2, Q = <Psi^dag B g0 Psi> = 8 d3; exact local Fock exchange -(lambda/32)(n^2 + S^2 - Q^2 - Y^2), Y = 8 d1 the y-current (zero for eigen-orbitals). The uniform-gas e_x omits +(lambda/32) Q^2.

checks.name: bc_fold_same_equation_on_both_halves
checks.detail: the fold cos z = 0 (y = 0) joins the halves z < pi/2 and z > pi/2 of a cell: z -> pi - z keeps y = ln|sin z|/(6H) and flips cot z, so e^x0 dx0 = f cot z dx0 = f dy on both halves, and gamma^mu Omega_mu is free of y: the reduced equation is the same on both halves, so a spinor continuous across the fold has the same chi(y) on both halves

checks.name: bc_fold_conditions
checks.detail: the boundary form of the doubled cell at the fold is 2 (-i j/f) phi^dag sigma1 chi(0) (the y direction points to the fold on both halves): self-adjointness needs (1 - Q(theta)) chi(0) = 0; theta = 0: chi2(0) = 0 (even), theta = pi: chi1(0) = 0 (odd), both kill the current chi^dag sigma1 chi, a general chi(0) does not. ASSUMED (the record's convention): both are solved and filled together, each orbital normalised on one half (w = 1/2)

checks.name: bc_self_adjoint_boundary_term
checks.detail: phi^dag h_j chi - (h_j phi)^dag chi = d/dy[-(i j/f) phi^dag sigma1 chi] pointwise: with current-killing conditions at both ends h_j is self-adjoint in the flat measure int dy (levels real, orbitals orthogonal)

checks.name: bc_tip_family
checks.detail: tip family (1 - Q(theta)) chi(-L) = 0, Q = cos(theta) sigma3 + sin(theta) sigma2 (16-component: cos(theta) gamma^(x0) + i sin(theta) gamma^(x0) gamma^(x1)): Q^dag = Q, Q^2 = 1, {Q, sigma1} = 0, so the current vanishes; canonical theta = 0: chi2(-L) = 0 (b(-L) = 0)

checks.name: bc_current_conserved_along_y
checks.detail: chi' = f N chi with N^dag sigma1 + sigma1 N = 0 for real (epsilon, M, v, kappa k): chi^dag sigma1 chi is constant in y on every solution (so zero everywhere for an eigen-orbital); N + N^dag = 2M sigma3 - 2 kappa k sigma2 != 0: the Hilbert density chi^dag chi is not

checks.name: bc_exact_k0_spectra
checks.detail: k = 0, constant M > 0, v = 0, tip theta = 0 (chi' = f N chi): even: chiral zero mode epsilon = 0, chi = (e^{f M y}, 0) (fold-localised, every L) and epsilon = +-sqrt(M^2 + (n pi/(f L))^2), chi2 ~ sin(n pi y/L); odd: epsilon^2 = M^2 + p^2 with M sin(p f L) + p cos(p f L) = 0, i.e. tan(p f L) = -p/M; each level 4-fold per j (f L = the proper hidden length)

checks.name: bc_tip_asymptotics
checks.detail: N^2 = (M^2 + kappa^2 k^2 - (eps - v)^2) 1: for constant M, v the branches are e^{+- f lambda y}, lambda = sqrt(M^2 + kappa^2 k^2 - (eps - v)^2), kappa = e^{-a4} constant in y: nothing suppresses an orbital toward the tip (in the metric of 2026-10-14 kappa = e^{-Hy-a4} grew toward the tip); the extended levels depend on L like a box of proper length f L

checks.name: rescaling_identity
checks.detail: in the proper hidden coordinate Y = f0 y (f0 = e^{-a4,0} b4,0^{1/2}): h_j = j[-(i/f0) sigma1 d_y + M sigma2 + e^{-a4,0} k sigma3] = j[-i sigma1 d_Y + M sigma2 + (k e^{-a4,0}) sigma3], e^{-3Hy} = e^{-3 (H/f0) Y}, chi_Y = chi/sqrt(f0), and the proper density factor P = e^{-3Hy} e^{a4,0}/(ell^3 v_t b4,0^2) equals P'(Y)/f0 of the slice a4 = 0, b4 = 1 with H/f0, ell e^{a4,0}, v_t e^{-3 a4,0} b4,0^{3/2}: KS(a4,0, b4,0; H, L, Delta k, v_t, lambda) = KS(0, 1; H/f0, f0 L, Delta k e^{-a4,0}, v_t e^{-3 a4,0} b4,0^{3/2}, lambda) exactly; on the history b4 = e^{(4/3) a4}: f0 = e^{-a4,0/3}

checks.name: ks_coupling_volume_scaling
checks.detail: with every density = (orbital sum)/Vol: M_eff - m = (15/16) lambda S, v_v = -lambda n/16 and the interaction energy Vol e_int are invariant under (lambda, Vol) -> (c lambda, c Vol): a Kohn-Sham state depends on the coupling and the cell volume only through lambda/Vol

checks.name: history_solver_units
checks.detail: on the history b4 = b4(0) e^{beta a4} the proper density factor is P = b4(0)^{-2} e^{-3Hy}/Vol_7(a4,0), Vol_7 = ell^3 v_t e^{(2 beta - 1) a4,0} (beta = 4/3: e^{(5/3) a4,0}); the solver uses lambda_hat = lambda b4(0)^{-2} and the densities per Vol_7, so lambda n_proper = lambda_hat n_solver; equivalently the slice state is that of the coordinate cell at lambda_eff = lambda_hat e^{-(5/3) a4,0}; b4(0) also enters f0 = b4(0)^{1/2} e^{-a4,0/3}, and the record uses b4(0) = 1

checks.name: emt_orbital_components
checks.detail: K^mu_mu(no sum) = (1/2)[Psibar g^mu D_mu Psi - (D_mu Psibar) g^mu Psi] in the expectation rule, for Psi = e^{-i eps x4 + i k x1} e^{-(3/2)Hy} e^{a4/2} b4^{-1} V_beta chi /sqrt(ell^3 v_t), a4 = a4(x4) and b4 = b4(x4) general (the spin connection drops out of every diagonal component): -K^x1_x1 = P kappa k chi^dag j s3 chi, K^x4_x4 = P eps chi^dag chi, K^x2_x2 = K^x5_x5 = 0, -K^y_y = P[(eps - v) chi^dag chi - M chi^dag j s2 chi - kappa k chi^dag j s3 chi] (on shell, chi' = f N chi), P = e^{-3Hy} e^{a4} b4^{-2}/(ell^3 v_t) (per proper 7-volume), kappa = e^{-a4}; K_x4y = f P (eps - v/2) chi^dag j s1 chi (zero for eigen-orbitals). block 0 (1, 1, 1): K11 True, K44 True, K22=K55=0 True, Kyy True, K_x4y = f P (eps - v/2) c True; block 5 (-1, 1, -1): K11 True, K44 True, K22=K55=0 True, Kyy True, K_x4y = f P (eps - v/2) c True

checks.name: emt_trace_identity
checks.detail: sum_mu K^mu_mu = M_eff s + v_v n per orbital (K^1+K^4+K^y), the on-shell trace; with <L> = e_int: T^mu_nu = -<K^mu_nu> + delta^mu_nu e_int (SPEC sign: rho = -T^x4_x4, p_mu = T^mu_mu; homogeneous classical limit rho = mS + U, p = S U' - U)

checks.name: emt_y_conservation_orbital
checks.detail: for one orbital in external M(y), v(y) (chi' = f N chi, kappa constant in y): d/dy[(eps - v) n_c - M s_c - kappa k t_c] = -v' n_c - M' s_c

checks.name: emt_y_conservation_selfconsistent
checks.detail: nabla_mu T^mu_y = p0' + 3H (p0 - p_t) for diagonal T(y, x4) (p3 does not enter: 3-space has no warp along y); summing the orbital identity with the factor P ~ e^{-3Hy} and adding e_int, the force terms -M' S - v' n + e_int' cancel exactly for the self-consistent M_eff, v_v: every self-consistent KS state satisfies p0' = -3H (p0 - e_int) = -3H (p0 - p_t)

checks.name: emt_x4_component
checks.detail: with a4 = a4(x4), b4 = b4(x4): nabla_mu T^mu_x4 = -d_x4 rho - 3 a4' (rho + p3) - 3 h4 (rho + p_t) - h4 (rho + p0), h4 = b4'/(2 b4) - a4' (+ the y-flux divergence, zero for the instantaneous states)

checks.name: emt_energy_change_history
checks.detail: with sqrt|g| = e^{-a4} b4^2 e^{3Hy} and the conservation law: d_x4 (e^{-a4} b4^2 rho) = e^{-a4} b4^2 (-3 a4' p3 - 3 h4 p_t - h4 p0) (+ the y-flux, zero for eigen-orbitals); on the history a4 = A H x4, b4 = b4(0) e^{beta A H x4}: dE/da4 = -3 P3 - 3 (beta/2 - 1) P_t - (beta/2 - 1) P0, P = 2 Vol_7(a4,0) int e^{3Hy} p dy (beta = 4/3: -3 P3 + P_t + P0/3), the solver check

checks.name: adiabatic_hellmann_feynman
checks.detail: along the history (b4 = b4(0) e^{beta a4}, f = b4(0)^{1/2} e^{(beta/2 - 1) a4}) with frozen potentials: d_a h_j = -j kappa k sigma3 + (1 - beta/2) j (-(i/f) sigma1 d_y) (beta = 4/3: + (1/3) times the kinetic term); d eps_n/da = <n| d_a h_j |n> (Hellmann-Feynman, fixed occupations), summed with the occupations it gives the history identity of emt_energy_change_history

checks.name: adiabatic_offdiagonal_identity
checks.detail: <n| d_a h |m> = (eps_m - eps_n) <n| d_a m> (differentiated eigen-equation; verified on an explicit family); measure along a4 = A H x4, b4 = b4(0) e^{beta A H x4}: Q_nm = A H |<n| d_a h_KS |m>| / (eps_n - eps_m)^2 for n occupied, m empty, same (k, block, fold condition); leading-order transition probability ~ Q_nm^2. The history is a PRESCRIBED BACKGROUND (test field without back-reaction, not a solution of the a4 and b4 equations with the Kohn-Sham source)

checks.name: brane_band_slope
checks.detail: first-order Hellmann-Feynman at k = 0 (zero mode e^{f M y}, theta = 0, <sigma3> = 1, kappa constant in y): d eps/dk = j c, c = e^{-a4,0} for every M, L, f; independent RK4 shooting (6000 steps, M = 1, L = 3, k = +-1e-3 and +-2e-3 with Richardson extrapolation, j = +1): slope 1.0000000000 at a4,0 = 0, f = 1 and 0.6065306597 at a4,0 = 0.5, f = e^{-1/6} (the history; exact 0.6065306597)

checks.name: ks_theory_json_basis
checks.detail: the exported basis 2 sqrt2 V of ks-theory.json equals this file's construction entry by entry

checks.name: ks_theory_json_exchange
checks.detail: exchange coefficients -1/32, -1/32 and potentials 15/16, -1/16 agree

checks.name: ks_theory_json_slope
checks.detail: the exported brane-band slopes (NDSolve) agree with c = e^{-a4,0} to 1e-8 and with this file's RK4 shooting to 1e-6

checks.name: ks_theory_json_history_label
checks.detail: ks-theory.json labels the history a4 = A H x4, b4 = b4(0) e^{beta A H x4} (A = 1, beta = 4/3, b4(0) = 1) of the adiabatic measure as a PRESCRIBED BACKGROUND and cites the source-condition report: True; the record history and its source are those of Revision/field_equations_a4/a4-equations.json (exponentialHistory.authorWeights, corrected metric): True; the source-condition report of the Kohn-Sham states (Revision/field_equations_a4/reports/ks-source-conditions.json) is the one of the corrected metric and its check ks_history_is_a_prescribed_background PASSes: True. The Kohn-Sham gas is a test field on this background without back-reaction
